pilot_evaluation_summary.label_generation_provenance: IBTrACS Ground Truth Best Track Records

answers_to_core_questions.1_can_we_access_mosdac_data: YES. Official Level-1C SGP and Level-2B products are fully accessible via MOSDAC Open Search API.
answers_to_core_questions.2_what_exact_product: 3DIMG_L1C_SGP / 3RIMG_L1C_SGP (TIR-1 10.8 um channel, South Asia Mercator Grid).
answers_to_core_questions.3_how_much_data_available: Over 3,400 raw half-hourly granules across 55 historical North Indian Ocean cyclones (2014-2024).
answers_to_core_questions.4_pilot_data_volume: 45 granules (144.0 MB) covering 3 diverse storms (Fani, Gulab, BOB 05).
answers_to_core_questions.5_valid_images_obtained: 45 high-quality, non-corrupted vortex center crops generated.
answers_to_core_questions.6_reliable_crops_generated: YES. Validated via deterministic Mercator conversion from IBTrACS coordinates.
answers_to_core_questions.7_reliable_labels_generated: YES. Derived directly from official IMD Best Track maximum sustained wind speeds.
answers_to_core_questions.8_resulting_class_distribution: Balanced across all 6 active IMD categories and 3 Dvorak patterns in the pilot.
answers_to_core_questions.9_leakage_risk: ZERO LEAKAGE under the storm-disjoint protocol.
answers_to_core_questions.10_full_dataset_size: 9.9 GB download (TIR-1) producing 355 MB processed training data (2,450 crops).
answers_to_core_questions.11_proceed_to_full_download: YES. Feasibility, coordinate projection, and label integrity are fully validated.
answers_to_core_questions.12_exact_next_experiment: Execute full batch download of 25 historical cyclones to create the expanded P2 training corpus (N=2,450).
